$comment: Shipped defaults for macho-explorer. Every value here is a site-specific fact
rather than a property of the Mach-O format, which is why it is data.

$comment.override.noRepoLocal: there is deliberately no cwd walk-up: these tools are run as CLIs from anywhere, and a config found by accident in an unrelated directory is worse than no config

bundle.$comment: the macOS application-bundle convention. macosDir is an array of path segments so it is composed with path.join rather than a hardcoded separator.

fallback.$comment: last-resort target for a bare invocation: a Mach-O that exists on every machine this runs on, so a tool prints something useful rather than a usage error. null on platforms with no such guarantee. Overridable per run with MACHO_BINARY.

scan.$comment: buffer chunking for whole-file searches. These are performance knobs, not correctness: chunk and overlap change how fast a search runs, never what it finds.
